dex.text: A cast-iron duckling that paddles along the canal with a faint clank. Floats perfectly well, which annoys the physics teacher no end.
dex.fact: Canal boats are still pulled along the old towpaths in places: the Llangollen Canal has had horse-drawn trip boats for more than a hundred years.

dex.text: Stands astride the valley on tall stone legs with a whole canal running down its back. Narrowboats cross it and wave. It is far too dignified to wave back.
dex.fact: Thomas Telford's Pontcysyllte Aqueduct, opened in 1805, carries the Llangollen Canal in a cast-iron trough 38 metres above the River Dee. It is the highest in Britain.
